help.intro: Everything the interface does also works straight from the terminal:
settings.local_only: Show agents of this machine only
settings.proxy_hint: Behind a corporate proxy enter it here, otherwise the connection fails. Format: http://HOST:PORT.
settings.pool_hint: One name and a comma separated list of agent names per pool. The active pool is used for new agents.
settings.db_hint: The message bus is a SQLite database in WAL mode. Writing goes exclusively through the sanctuary command so that there is exactly one writer.
about.description:
Control center for several Claude Code
sessions running side by side
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: This application observes Claude Code sessions on your machines, hands tasks to them and can end sessions. It therefore performs actions that may change data.
disclaimer.duty_authorisation: You are authorised to control the machines and sessions involved.
disclaimer.duty_actions: You are responsible for what the commissioned agents do - the program does not review tasks for content.
disclaimer.duty_data: You will not pass data over the message bus that has no business being on the target machine.
tip.version: Claude Code version of this session. If it differs between machines, an update is due there.
detail.name: Name
quick.compact_text: Please run /compact - your context is nearly full.
quick.status_text: Please give a short progress update: what are you working on?
quick.pause_text: Please pause the current work and wait for further instructions.
quick.done_text: Please bring the current task to a close and summarise.
quick.hint: Quick phrases - they fill the input, sending still needs the button
notify.remote_dir: {name} runs on {rechner} - that folder is not here
tooltip.usage: Determine token usage (reads all transcripts, slow)
shot.title: Screen of {rechner}   ({groesse})
tooltip.broadcast: Sends a text to every visible agent - one separate task each.
tooltip.restart: Stops the selected agent and resumes the same session right away.
broadcast.title: Message to all agents
broadcast.nobody: No agent around to write to.
broadcast.partly: {anzahl} of {gesamt} delivered - the rest is in the log.
confirm.restart_text: Stop {name} and resume the session right away? The conversation is kept, the Claude version is reloaded.
notify.no_session: No session id known for this agent - there is nothing to resume.
settings.terminal_hint: What a new agent is opened with. Only what is installed on this machine is offered.
settings.terminal_script_ph: Path to a script that runs beforehand
settings.terminal_prepare_hint: One command per line. They run in the new terminal before Claude starts - meant for proxy setup and similar groundwork. If a script is set as well, it runs first.
settings.update_hint: How Claude Code is updated on the agent machines. The method has to match the installation - it is deliberately not guessed, because a wrong one reports success without changing anything.
filepick.title: Choose a script
cmd.watch: redraw continuously, --json turns it into a stream

cmd.stop: stop an instance, --force skips the prompt

cmd.motif: show or switch the naming motif
cmd.send: file a task, --expect-receipt asks for a reply
cmd.tasks: the queue, independent of the read marker
cmd.history: tasks and receipts with one agent
